description: Runs AI governance, risk and compliance programs.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Certified AI Governance Professional

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must hold a current course certificate for each of these courses: AI Governance and Risk Management: NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 (GOV-201); The EU AI Act in Practice (GOV-210); Implementing ISO/IEC 42001: Building an AI Management System (GOV-310); AI Audit and Assurance (GOV-320). Every course certificate must be current (not revoked or expired) when the program certificate is issued; the program certificate is renewed when every course certificate is current again.

Each course exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a program certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
